description: Lists the newest pack openings on Collector Crypt across every site that sells its packs, newest first (from the latest ~200): card, insured value, rarity, pack and its price, how many times the pack price the card was worth, and when. Use it to show what people are really getting right now, optionally for one pack, one rarity or above a value; use search_cards for cards still waiting in a pool. Read-only; the feed is at most 30 seconds old and wallets are shortened.

code.description: Pack code from list_packs, lowercase, e.g. pokemon_50, onepiece_250, soccer_100.

limit.description: How many pulls to return, 1 to 50 (default 20).

min_value.description: Only cards worth at least this many US$, e.g. 100.

rarity.description: Only pulls of this rarity, e.g. epic.

name: list_recent_pulls
title: What people just pulled
